short_bio: American author and science communicator, co-creator of Crash Course and SciShow.
biography:
Hank Green was born in Birmingham, Alabama, and studied biochemistry at Eckerd College. In 2007 he and his brother, the novelist John Green, began the Vlogbrothers video series.

He co-founded the VidCon convention in 2010, helped start the educational series Crash Course in 2011 and created SciShow in 2012. His company Complexly produces his educational channels.

His first novel, An Absolutely Remarkable Thing (2018), was a bestseller.
